Arabic text: بِسْمِ اللَّـهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ وَحَمَلَةُ عَرْشِكَ الَّذِيْنَ لَا يَفْتُرُونَ مِنْ تَسْبِيحِكَ
Translation: O Allah, and the bearers of Your Throne who never tire from glorifying You

Arabic text: وَلَا يَسْـأَمُـونَ مِنْ تَقْـدِيْسِكَ
Translation: And never weary from sanctifying You

Arabic text: وَلَا يَسْتَحسِرُونَ مِنْ عِبَادَتِكَ
Translation: And never become exhausted from worshipping You

Arabic text: وَلَا يُؤْثِرُونَ التَّقْصِيرَ عَلَى الْجِدِّ فِيْ أَمْرِكَ
Translation: And never prefer negligence over diligence in Your command

Arabic text: وَلَا يَغْفُلُونَ عَنِ الْوَلَهِ إلَيْكَ
Translation: And never become heedless of their devotion to You

Arabic text: وَإِسْرَافِيْلُ صَاحِبُ الصُّوْرِ، اَلشَّاخِصُ الَّذِيْ يَنْتَظِرُ
Translation: And Israfil, the keeper of the Trumpet, who vigilantly awaits

Arabic text: مِنْكَ الْإِذْنَ وَحُلُوْلَ الَامْرِ، فَيُنَبِّهُ بِالنَّفْخَةِ
Translation: Your permission and command, who will awaken with a blast

Arabic text: صَرْعَى رَهَائِنِ الْقُبُورِ وَمِيْكَائِيْلُ ذُوْ الْجَاهِ عِنْدَكَ
Translation: Those lying in their graves, and Mikael, who has high status with You

Arabic text: وَالْمَكَانِ الرَّفِيعِ مِنْ طَاعَتِكَ
Translation: And an elevated position due to his obedience to You

Arabic text: وَجِبْريلُ الَامِيْنُ عَلَى وَحْيِكَ
Translation: And Gabriel, the trustworthy bearer of Your revelation

Arabic text: اَلْمُطَاعُ فِيْ أَهْلِ سَمَاوَاتِكَ
Translation: Who is obeyed by the inhabitants of Your heavens

Arabic text: اَلْمَكِينُ لَدَيْكَ، الْمُقَرَّبُ عِنْدَكَ
Translation: Who holds a secure position with You, and is close to You

Arabic text: وَالرُّوْحُ الَّذِيْ هُوَ عَلَى مَلَائِكَةِ الْحُجُبِ
Translation: And the Spirit who is over the angels of the veils

Arabic text: وَالرُّوْحُ الَّذِيْ هُوَ مِنْ أَمْرِكَ
Translation: And the Spirit who is from Your command

Arabic text: فَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِمْ وَعَلَى الْمَلَائِكَةِ
Translation: So send blessings upon them and upon the angels

Arabic text: اَلَّذِيْنَ مِنْ دُونِهِمْ مِنْ سُكَّانِ سَمَاوَاتِكَ
Translation: Who are below them among the dwellers of Your heavens

Arabic text: وَأَهْلِ الْأَمَانَةِ عَلَى رِسَالَاتِكَ
Translation: And the bearers of trust for Your messages

Arabic text: وَالَّذِيْنَ لَا تَدْخُلُهُمْ سَأْمَةٌ مِنْ دُؤُوْب
Translation: And those who are never affected by weariness from constant work

Arabic text: وَلَا أَعْيَاءٌ مِنْ لُغُوب وَلَا فُتُورٌ
Translation: Nor by fatigue, exhaustion, or weakness

Arabic text: وَلَا تَشْغَلُهُمْ عَنْ تَسْبِيحِكَ الشَّهَوَاتُ
Translation: And whom desires do not distract from glorifying You

Arabic text: وَلَا يَقْطَعُهُمْ عَنْ تَعْظِيمِكَ سَهْوُ الْغَفَلاَتِ
Translation: And whom the forgetfulness of negligence does not cut off from exalting You

Arabic text: اَلْخُشَّعُ الَابْصَارِ فَلَا يَرُومُوْنَ النَّظَرَ إلَيْكَ
Translation: Those with lowered gazes who do not attempt to look at You

Arabic text: اَلنَّوَاكِسُ الَاذْقَانِ الَّذِيْنَ قَدْ طَالَتْ رَغْبَتُهُمْ فِيمَا لَدَيْكَ
Translation: Those with heads bowed whose desire for what is with You has grown long

Arabic text: اَلْمُسْتَهْتِرُونَ بِذِكْرِ آلاَئِكَ
Translation: Those who are enchanted by the mention of Your blessings

Arabic text: وَالْمُتَوَاضِعُونَ دُوْنَ عَظَمَتِكَ وَجَلاَلِ كِبْرِيَائِكَ
Translation: And those who humble themselves before Your greatness and the majesty of Your grandeur

Arabic text: وَالَّذِيْنَ يَقُولُونَ إِذَا نَظَرُوْا إِلَى جَهَنَّمَ تَزْفِرُ عَلَى أَهْلِ مَعْصِيَتِكَ
Translation: And those who say, when they look at Hell roaring over the people who disobeyed You

Arabic text: سُبْحَانَكَ مَا عَبَدْنَاكَ حَقَّ عِبَادَتِكَ
Translation: "Glory be to You, we have not worshipped You as You deserve to be worshipped"

Arabic text: فَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِمْ وَعَلَى الرَّوْحَانِيِّينَ مِنْ مَلَائِكَتِكَ
Translation: So send blessings upon them and upon the spiritual ones among Your angels

Arabic text: وَأَهْلِ الزُّلْفَةِ عِنْدَكَ، وَحُمَّالِ الْغَيْبِ إِلَى رُسُلِكَ
Translation: And those close to You, and the bearers of the unseen to Your messengers

Arabic text: وَالْمُؤْتَمَنِيْنَ عَلَى وَحْيِكَ وَقَبَائِلِ الْمَلَائِكَةِ الَّذِيْنَ اخْتَصَصْتَهُمْ لِنَفْسِكَ
Translation: And those entrusted with Your revelation, and the tribes of angels whom You have chosen for Yourself

Arabic text: وَأَغْنَيْتَهُمْ عَنِ الطَّعَامِ وَالشَّرَابِ بِتَقْدِيسِكَ
Translation: And whom You have freed from the need for food and drink through Your sanctification

Arabic text: وَأَسْكَنْتَهُمْ بُطُونَ أَطْبَاقِ سَمَاوَاتِكَ
Translation: And whom You have settled in the interiors of the layers of Your heavens

Arabic text: وَالَّذِيْنَ عَلَى أَرْجَائِهَا إِذَا نَزَلَ الَامْرُ بِتَمَامِ وَعْدِكَ
Translation: And those who are at its borders when the command descends with the fulfillment of Your promise

Arabic text: وَخُزَّانِ الْمَطَرِ وَزَوَاجِرِ السَّحَابِ
Translation: And the keepers of rain and the drivers of clouds

Arabic text: وَالَّذِيْ بِصَوْتِ زَجْرِهِ يُسْمَعُ زَجَلُ الرُّعُودِ
Translation: And the one whose driving sound causes the rumble of thunder to be heard

Arabic text: وَإِذَا سَبَحَتْ بِهِ حَفِيفَةُ السَّحَابِ الْتَمَعَتْ صَوَاعِقُ الْبُرُوقِ
Translation: And when the clouds rustle with his glorification, the thunderbolts of lightning flash

Arabic text: وَمُشَيِّعِيْ الثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ وَالْهَابِطِينَ مَعَ قَطْرِ الْمَطَرِ إِذَا نَزَلَ
Translation: And the escorts of snow and hail, and those who descend with the drops of rain when it falls

Arabic text: وَالْقُوَّامِ عَلَى خَزَائِنِ الرِّيَاحِ
Translation: And those in charge of the treasuries of the winds

Arabic text: وَالْمُوَكَّلِينَ بِالْجِبَالِ فَلَا تَزُولُ
Translation: And those assigned to the mountains so they do not move

Arabic text: وَالَّذِيْنَ عَرَّفْتَهُمْ مَثَاقِيلَ الْمِيَاهِ
Translation: And those whom You have taught the weights of waters

Arabic text: وَكَيْلَ مَا تَحْوِيهِ لَوَاعِجُ الَامْطَارِ وَعَوَالِجُهَا
Translation: And the measure of what the bursts and floods of rain contain

Arabic text: وَرُسُلِكَ مِنَ الْمَلَائِكَةِ إِلَى أَهْلِ الَارْضِ بِمَكْرُوهِ مَا يَنْزِلُ مِنَ الْبَلاءِ
Translation: And Your messengers from the angels to the people of earth with the unpleasant afflictions that descend

Arabic text: وَمَحْبُوبِ الرَّخَاءِ، وَالسَّفَرَةِ الْكِرَامِ الْبَرَرَةِ
Translation: And the pleasant ease, and the noble, righteous scribes

Arabic text: وَالْحَفَظَةِ الْكِرَامِ الْكَاتِبِينَ، وَمَلَكِ الْمَوْتِ وَأَعْوَانِهِ
Translation: And the noble recording guardians, and the Angel of Death and his assistants

Arabic text: وَمُنْكَر وَنَكِير، وَرُومَانَ فَتَّانِ الْقُبُورِ
Translation: And Munkar and Nakir, and Ruman, the examiner of graves

Arabic text: وَالطَّائِفِينَ بِالْبَيْتِ الْمَعْمُورِ، وَمَالِك
Translation: And those who circle around the Frequented House, and Malik

Arabic text: وَالْخَزَنَةِ، وَرِضْوَانَ، وَسَدَنَةِ الْجِنَانِ
Translation: And the keepers, and Ridwan, and the guardians of Paradise

Arabic text: وَالَّذِيْنَ لَا يَعْصُونَ اللَّهَ مَا أَمَرَهُمْ وَيَفْعَلُونَ مَا يُؤْمَرُونَ
Translation: And those who do not disobey Allah in what He commands them and do what they are commanded

Arabic text: وَالَّذِيْنَ يَقُولُونَ سَلاَمٌ عَلَيْكُمْ بِمَا صَبَرْتُمْ فَنِعْمَ عُقْبَى الدَّارِ
Translation: And those who say, "Peace be upon you for what you patiently endured. How excellent is the final home"

Arabic text: وَالزَّبَانِيَةِ الَّذِيْنَ إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ خُذُوهُ فَغُلُّوهُ
Translation: And the guardians of Hell who, when told, "Seize him and shackle him"

Arabic text: ثُمَّ الْجَحِيمَ صَلُّوهُ، اِبْتَدَرُوهُ سِرَاعًا وَلَمْ يُنْظِرُوهُ
Translation: "Then burn him in Hellfire," they rush to him quickly and do not give him respite

Arabic text: وَمَنْ أَوْهَمْنَا ذِكْرَهُ، وَلَمْ نَعْلَمْ مَكَانَهُ مِنْكَ
Translation: And those whom we have not mentioned, and whose position with You we do not know

Arabic text: وَبِأَيِّ أَمْرٍ وَكَّلْتَهُ وَسُكَّانَ الْهَوَاءِ وَالَارْضِ وَالْمَاءِ
Translation: And what task You have assigned them, and the dwellers of air, earth, and water

Arabic text: وَمَنْ مِنْهُمْ عَلَى الْخَلْقِ فَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِمْ
Translation: And those among them who are over creation, so send blessings upon them

Arabic text: يَوْمَ تَأْتِيْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَعَهَا سَائِقٌ وَشَهِيدٌ
Translation: On the Day when every soul will come with a driver and a witness

Arabic text: وَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِمْ صَلاَةً تَزِيدُهُمْ كَرَامَةً عَلَى كَرَامَتِهِمْ
Translation: And send blessings upon them - blessings that increase their honor upon their honor

Arabic text: وَطَهَارَةً عَلَى طَهَارَتِهِمْ
Translation: And purity upon their purity

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ وَإِذَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى مَلَائِكَتِكَ وَرُسُلِكَ
Translation: O Allah, when You send blessings upon Your angels and messengers

Arabic text: وَبَلَّغْتَهُمْ صَلاَتَنَا عَلَيْهِمْ، فَصَلِّ عَلَيْنَا
Translation: And convey to them our blessings upon them, then send blessings upon us

Arabic text: بِمَا فَتَحْتَ لَنَا مِنْ حُسْنِ الْقَوْلِ فِيهِمْ إِنَّكَ جَوَادٌ كَرِيمٌ
Translation: For what You have opened for us of good words regarding them. Indeed, You are Generous, Noble
